findings.text: The after arm the manifest cites as completed with exit_status 0 ends at a progress-dot line with no pytest summary and no EXIT= line (the file is 3 lines, 647 bytes), so its declared failure_count 0 is not readable from the cited receipt; a re-run of the node gate (tests/test_a_dispatch_waits_for_the_router.py, 9 passed in 11.66 s) confirms the node's own tests pass, but the suite receipt should be re-captured with its summary and EXIT line.

assert items[0]["route_step"] == "pick:snapshot" compares the function's output against the exact string the test placed in the pointer it handed to _route_defaulted_items, so it verifies key selection but would pass for any implementation that echoed that field; the detail substring assertion on line 434 has the same shape against the value the test supplied.

The obligations listing is exercised only with a hand-built pointer, and the view-level test at line 437 monkeypatches _route_defaulted_items, so no test drives a real dispatch whose route defaulted into the view; a break in the stored-pointer wiring (route_defaulted surviving _reportable_picker_selection and being read back by dispatch_field) would leave every test green.

The added dispatch_options parameter of _awaiting_pick_hold is never supplied by its only caller (plan_dispatch.py:1298), so the docstring's claim that due and urgency are carried off the request options is not realised; the owner still sets the keys with None values, but the parameter is dead on the production path.

justifications.durability: Five new tests at tests/test_a_dispatch_waits_for_the_router.py:184-470 are each shown failing by the negative-control log, but the route-defaulted listing is tested only through a hand-built pointer (line 407) and a monkeypatched _route_defaulted_items (line 437).
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_dispatch_waits_for_the_router.py asserts the four done-when cases and the negative-control log shows six mutations each reddening its own check, but logs/after-arm.log:3 carries no summary or EXIT line so the suite receipt is unreadable as recorded.
justifications.fit: The additions follow the surrounding lazy-import and WHY-comment idiom (reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:56-75, obligations.py:1629) and introduce no forbidden plan, sprint or ticket names.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:56 and 683, dispatch_plan.py:1298 and obligations.py:1632 each deliver one of s59's named behaviours, and every one of the seven prior findings is addressed in dbecafe.
justifications.reuse: The dispatcher delegates to the existing owners rather than copying them: picker.__init__:73 calls dispatch_picker.picker_dispatch_timeout, dispatch_picker.py:96 delegates to picker._declared_difficulty, and dispatch_plan.py:1348 builds the held request through dispatching.requests._queued_request_record.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff abb1956..dbecafe names only the five files in the review scope, and nothing the goal does not imply was edited.
